question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

GRAM : EPYK :: HALT : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**The alphabet positional value is subtracted with 2.**

 
• GRAM : EPYK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb1ea8bb3ef8afedc1a97290fc4b50b92ba613ba68f1d33d0f0ec2cdec10949.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HALT : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bc59f236e007691d74b79a9ace23243f9af4c8d6332e25b9fbedfc5d579c8a7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FYJR".**
